g.text: Startup: hold DI/HPFP commands and DRVEN low; ARM bank power; wait for rails; reset/program/verify PT; then permit DRVEN.

g.desc: Startup: hold DI/HPFP commands and DRVEN low; ARM bank power; wait for rails; reset/program/verify PT; then permit DRVEN.

g.text: External fuse is REQUIRED; this controller has no precision overcurrent limit. Fuse rating depends on load and harness.

g.desc: External fuse is REQUIRED; this controller has no precision overcurrent limit. Fuse rating depends on load and harness.

g.text: Power removal does not instantly remove stored boost energy. DRVEN hardware inhibit remains a separate path.

g.desc: Power removal does not instantly remove stored boost energy. DRVEN hardware inhibit remains a separate path.

g.text: GDI B INPUT: separate externally fused battery feed

g.desc: GDI B INPUT: separate externally fused battery feed

g.text: OV disconnect protects the 5V regulator normal input envelope; dynamic overshoot has NOT been measured.

g.desc: OV disconnect protects the 5V regulator normal input envelope; dynamic overshoot has NOT been measured.

g.text: LM74800 exposed pad MUST FLOAT. Keep copper under pad isolated; do not use GND thermal vias.

g.desc: LM74800 exposed pad MUST FLOAT. Keep copper under pad isolated; do not use GND thermal vias.

g.text: Common-drain MOSFETs: input is Q1 SOURCE, midpoint joins DRAINS, output is Q2 SOURCE.

g.desc: Common-drain MOSFETs: input is Q1 SOURCE, midpoint joins DRAINS, output is Q2 SOURCE.
